methods.body: Read actual existing model.glb meshes via trimesh. Compare enclosure convex envelope to the independent SDK body contour normalized to published width/height, matching pending 0.10 mm check concept. No stale front.png judgment.
methods.rail: Manual pixel-boundary reading on straight left rail away from buttons, with top/bottom/right cross-checks. Separate coated outside, gasket, bright rounded cover-glass bevel and inner black/OLED area. front_rail_mm represents body-to-glass-start including gasket, not OLED bezel thickness. A single inset is a conservative summary of asymmetric shading, not CAD.
methods.cutout: 4a/5: scipy connected component of opaque SDK mask, excluding edge-touching rounded corners; radius=sqrt(area/pi)*height-anchored mm/pixel. Pixel4: visible forehead camera bounds in each native frame, not a modern centered OLED hole. 5a: threshold max(RGB)<60 inside local camera ROI in official orthographic product image; equivalent-area radius 313 px.
methods.seams: Review original frame perimeter strips separately from OLED and screen corner contour. No resolved transverse antenna-insert discontinuities in the assigned SDK frames or the 5a product image. Empty seam lists mean unmeasured, not physical proof of no hidden antenna breaks. Never extrapolate Pixel9/10 seam coordinates.

licensing: Downloaded Google product photos and upstream art remain local research evidence. No blanket licensing assertion; no publication or gallery change.

upstream_4a5g.finding: Both decoded back.webp and mask.webp are byte-identical to installed pixel_4a files. Official origin confirmed, but this is shared artwork and not independent evidence of the physical 4a5G contour, glass boundary or camera aperture. Candidate trace exists only in tmp/pixel45/trace-work; NOT activated under research/skins/pixel-4a-5g. Parent should not simply declare it a calibrated genuine 4a5G body.

common_helper_handoff.front_glass: Keep profile front_rail_mm independent of OLED bezel. Form glass from the independently traced BODY contour inset by measured glass boundary. Preserve the outer coated rail RGB/finish; separate dark gasket from a rounded reflective cover-glass bevel. Do not recolor that glass highlight as bare aluminum. A dedicated front glass material can use a low roughness illustrative value; do not change shared black used by cavities/ports. Existing global black roughness is 0.5 and cannot express both these surfaces.
common_helper_handoff.selfie: Replace the flat disk with an annular dark housing, recessed pupil/curved optical element and one clear coated optical surface. The measured cutout radius is the maximum housing footprint, never the lens pupil radius. 4a/5 equivalent-area mask radius defines outer footprint, not a manufacturer optical prescription. Pixel4 only its visible selfie aperture becomes an optical stack; adjacent measured capsule stays a subdued sensor window. Face-unlock IR/radar hardware stays hidden under the forehead glass. Do not emit three guessed extra visible pupils or a centered punch hole.
common_helper_handoff.seams: No measured antenna_breaks activation for these six models. Polymer 4a/4a5G and coated 5/5a must not receive generic bright metal antenna ribbons. Any future seam needs its own edge, source-axis pixel center/width, normalized coordinate, finish and region evidence.
common_helper_handoff.unresolved: Pixel4a5G physical front contour and optical aperture remain reference-limited. Pixel5a has an official Google photo but no official SDK body trace; do not reuse Pixel5 or Pixel4a contours and call them official.

source_generator_patch_instructions.instructions: After each existing model is assembled, reproduce the exact per-device profile corrections recorded below. Keep make_pixel_profiles.py and common geometry changes with parent. Preserve rear assemblies and finishing colors.

For the four assigned coated/polycarbonate unibody models only, rail visible-surface metallic=0 and roughness=.58 (illustrative, matched to existing back coating); do not change all unibody devices globally or the RGB palette. Pixel4/4XL stay metal=0 rough=.72.

Set each measured bezel_cameras list explicitly AFTER deepcopy/XL translations; do not inherit the smaller model camera X coordinate or add the same Y offset. Keep screen.create_cutouts false and screen.cutouts empty.
Existing pending internal-mask component extraction reproduces added screen_cutouts_mm for Pixel4,4XL,4a,5. Empty Pixel4 cutouts are intentional. Do not invoke the full scan in this worker.
